items.a: Create an API key in the console, use {baseUrl} as the APIPool API Endpoint, then follow the interface documentation for the model's protocol path and SDK configuration.
Flagship models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and ByteDance are live today — such as Claude-Opus-4.8, Claude-Sonnet-5, GPT-5.6 and Gemini-3-Pro — with more providers and models being added.

Metered per token (or per call for SKU-priced models) in real time, with no monthly fee and a balance that never expires. Top-ups start at $10, and the console shows usage dashboards and low-balance warnings.
APIPool supports Chat Completions and other common interfaces. SDKs join Base URLs and protocol paths differently, so use the matching configuration from the interface documentation.
Keys are encrypted and isolated, the public API is served over HTTPS, full audit logs are provided, and nothing is used for model training.
